title: Enrolment opens the same modal from three places
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset that has a customer, and a schedule to enrol it on. Seed them:
  3. ↳ Ensure a schedule exists (Settings > Maintenance > New schedule + at least one service).
  4. ↳ Open an asset that has a customer (from Customers > a customer > Assets, or from Work Orders) and open its Maintenance tab (the last tab on the asset page).
  5. Also have: an asset linked to more than one customer, an asset with no customer, and (to see the no-schedules state) an org/location with no schedules.
custom_steps:
1. Start enrolment from the asset's Maintenance tab (Enrol), from the maintenance panel on a work order, and from the customer's Assets tab; confirm the same modal opens.
  2. On an asset linked to more than one customer, see how the modal asks which customer.
  3. Try to enrol an asset with no customer.
  4. In an org/location with no schedules, open the modal.
  5. Try to pick a schedule the asset is already on.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • All three entry points open the same enrolment modal, offering the schedules of the location chosen in the header.
  • Enrolment is for one of the asset's customers; where the asset has more than one, the modal asks which (preselected when only one), and the asset appears once.
  • An asset with no customer cannot be enrolled; with no schedules the modal says so and offers the route to create one (not an empty control); a schedule the asset is already on is not offered.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10564 (S7, Enrol an asset onto a schedule); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S7; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R1: “Enrolment starts from the asset's Maintenance tab, from the maintenance panel on a work order, or for several assets at once from the customer's Assets tab. All three open the same modal, which offers the schedules of the location chosen in the header”
  • S7-R23: “Enrolment is for one of the asset's customers. Where the asset is linked to more than one customer, the modal asks which, preselected where there is only one”
  • S7-N1: “An asset with no customer cannot be enrolled”
  • S7-N6: “Where the organization has no schedules, the enrolment modal says so plainly and offers the route to create one rather than presenting an empty control”
  • S7-E8: “A schedule the asset is already on is not offered in the modal”
